name: TruthOpen
description: Clicking a prediction selects and opens the ground-truth feature it predicts, in another layer, and reports the offset between them.

components.name: Ground-truth Layers
components.description: A comma-separated array of names or UUIDs of the ground-truth layers to search. This duplicates the TruthOffset attachment's identical setting: a plugin may not read another plugin's config subtree, and there is no shared place for a per-layer fact two families need.

components.name: Match Property
components.description: The feature property that must be equal in a prediction and its ground truth. Defaults to _crossrefTruthId, which the orbitalprediction layer type stamps.

components.name: Max Offset (m)
components.description: Do not open a ground-truth feature further away than this.
